stem: What is one reason scientists are excited about the idea of using Coralbots to restore reefs?

options.label: F
options.text: Coralbots will imitate insects and birds.

options.label: G
options.text: Programming Coralbots takes less time than training a diver.

options.label: H
options.text: Coralbots are unlikely to cause more damage to a reef.

options.label: J
options.text: Coralbots will be able to repair reefs more effectively than divers can.
